dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped perimeters with sharp gradient transitions from dark interior cores to high-intensity white/cream outer borders, primarily distributed along the upper dorsal midline with jagged, variable thickness edges.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of dark, low-intensity interior blobs nested within the annuli network; localized clusters of high-intensity white pixels lacking internal gradients are visible near the caudal and cranial-lateral regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the five most distinct dorsal-lateral annuli form a complex, elongated pentagonal arrangement, with the three largest structures defining a prominent central axis along the upper ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinct high-contrast transition zone near the cranial region where the large macro-annuli topology breaks into a higher density of smaller, discrete micro-spots on a lighter background.
